backendQuotaError: Model quota exceeded (monthly token limit): the server keeps retrying but will never succeed — stop this turn and switch model/plan, or wait for the quota to reset
sessionInactiveHint: The session is inactive on the server (common after a CLI upgrade/restart); the plugin resumes it automatically and retries. If it still fails, reopen the session from the history list and send again
modelSwitchDeferred: Model switch will take effect after the current turn: {{model}}
streamLost: No stream events for over a minute and no server-side progress; this turn was closed as interrupted. If the task is unfinished, send again (sessions resumed after a CLI upgrade/restart may not emit events)
promptRunningHint: The previous turn is still running and auto-stop failed. Try again later, or click Stop to end the current generation before sending
resumeBusyHint: The session may still be resuming (the server needs ~1-2 minutes to digest a recovered interrupted turn); the plugin retries subscribing and settings automatically — do not restart the IDE. Thought-level and other settings return once recovered
dialogCountdownTitle: If unanswered until timeout, the request is auto-declined and the dialog closes

newSession.title: New Session
newSession.message: A new blank session will be started (created only when the first message is sent). The current session will be kept in history and can be switched back to at any time. Start a new session?

planApproval.title: Plan Approval
planApproval.hint: Once approved, plan mode will be exited and execution will begin
planApproval.tip: Declining or not answering before timeout keeps plan mode
planApproval.feedbackPlaceholder: Describe changes; the AI will keep refining the plan…

status.viewSubagentDetail: Click to view subagent execution details
status.viewDiff: View diff before and after edits

envBanner.title: Runtime environment issue — plugin unavailable
envBanner.nodeTooLow: Node.js version too low ({{version}}, requires v{{min}}+)
envBanner.browserHostCefDown: Browser debug channel unavailable: JCEF is running but the CDP port is unreachable. Restart the IDE to recover (Recheck will attempt auto-repair)
envBanner.browserHostHandlerMissing: Browser host is not registered with the protocol client. Click "Recheck" to re-register
envBanner.credsDegraded: No usable model credential found: upgrade the ZCode client to the latest version and log in again (or add an API-key provider in the client), then click "Recheck"
envBanner.dismiss: Dismiss (does not affect features; shows again after IDE restart if still degraded)

envErrors.nodeNotFound: searched PATH, common install locations and login shell; set the path in Settings
envErrors.nodePackageManager: {{arg}} is a package manager, not the Node.js executable
envErrors.nodeIsScript: {{arg}} is a JS script, not the Node.js executable (zcode.cjs belongs in the ZCode CLI path field)
envErrors.cliNotFound: zcode.cjs not found in standard install locations. Please install the ZCode client first
envErrors.credsMissing: config file does not exist: {{arg}} (upgrade the ZCode client to the latest version and log in again, or add an API-key provider, then recheck)
envErrors.credsInvalid: no usable credential in config file: {{arg}} (account-login credentials are stored encrypted; upgrade the ZCode client to the latest version and log in again, or add an API-key provider, then recheck)
